summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing plans to submit a Rare Pediatric Disease Designation request to the FDA for tecarfarin in pediatric Kawasaki disease patients with coronary artery aneurysms. The company also disclosed a dual-track portfolio strategy: a Global Pharma Track focused on the 12-LOX inhibitor CAD-1005, and a Regional Rare Disease Track centered on tecarfarin. The disclosure is furnished under Items 7.01 and 8.01, not filed for Exchange Act liability purposes. No transaction or deal terms are present; this is a routine business development update.
